fields.description: The Ferrari SF90 Stradale is the first plug-in hybrid supercar from Maranello. It combines a twin-turbo V8 with three electric motors to produce a combined 986 horsepower, delivering breathtaking performance while offering an all-electric range of 25 km. A true technological masterpiece.

The McLaren 720S embodies the brand's philosophy of lightweight supercars. With its carbon fiber Monocage II structure and a potent twin-turbo V8, it offers unparalleled agility and driver engagement. The dihedral doors and futuristic design make it a standout anywhere.

The Aston Martin DB12 redefines the Grand Tourer. It combines breathtaking performance with handcrafted luxury. The V8 engine delivers 671 horsepower, while the interior features exquisite materials and state-of-the-art technology. A true driver's car for long-distance journeys.

The Rolls-Royce Ghost embodies effortless performance and supreme luxury. Powered by a twin-turbo V12, it glides silently on its air suspension. The interior is a sanctuary of handcrafted materials and advanced technology, offering the ultimate in comfort and refinement.

The 911 Turbo S represents the ultimate expression of Porsche engineering excellence. With its twin-turbocharged flat-six engine producing 640 horsepower, it delivers breathtaking acceleration while maintaining the everyday usability that defines the 911 lineage. This is where raw power meets refined elegance — a supercar that you can drive every day, yet one that will leave exotic rivals in its wake on any circuit.

The Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S is a four-door coupe that combines stunning design with race-track performance. Handcrafted by AMG, the biturbo V8 delivers explosive power, while the AMG Performance 4MATIC+ all-wheel drive ensures maximum traction in all conditions. With its luxurious interior and cutting-edge technology, it's a true gran turismo.

The Audi R8 V10 Performance is a mid-engine supercar that captures the essence of motorsport. Its naturally aspirated V10 engine produces a spine-tingling sound and instant throttle response. With Audi's legendary quattro all-wheel drive and lightweight construction, it offers precision handling and everyday usability.

The BMW M8 Competition combines luxury and performance in a striking grand tourer. Its twin-turbo V8 delivers immense power, while the M xDrive system provides precision and control. With exclusive M design elements and a driver-focused cockpit, it's a masterpiece of engineering.

The Lamborghini Huracán EVO is the evolution of the most successful V10 model in Lamborghini history. It combines advanced vehicle dynamics with aerodynamic design. The naturally aspirated V10 engine, together with all-wheel drive and Lamborghini's LDVI system, creates a driving experience like no other.
